pairs.target: chá dào zuìhòu , chēshàng háiyǒu yìzhī méirù dān de mùxiá .
pairs.english: At the end of the check, there was still a wooden box on the cart that wasn't on the list.
pairs.hanzi: 查到最后，车上还有一只没入单的木匣。

pairs.target: xiá gài quē le gè jiǎo , dǐxià què xīn diàn le yìcéng cǎo .
pairs.english: A corner of the lid was missing, but underneath was a fresh layer of straw.
pairs.hanzi: 匣盖缺了个角，底下却新垫了一层草。

pairs.target: huǒjì shēnshǒu yào bān , lín zhào ànzhù le dānzi .
pairs.english: The worker reached to lift it, and Lin Zhao held down the list.
pairs.hanzi: 伙计伸手要搬，林照按住了单子。

pairs.target: " zhè zhī yě xiè zài liǔ qiáo ? "
pairs.english: “Does this one come off at Willow Bridge too?”
pairs.hanzi: “这只也卸在柳桥？”

pairs.target: " nà shì wǒ de . "
pairs.english: “That is mine.”
pairs.hanzi: “那是我的。”

pairs.target: huī mào nánrén táiqǐ tóu ,
pairs.english: The man in the gray cap raised his head.
pairs.hanzi: 灰帽男人抬起头，

pairs.target: " lǐtou shì chèngtuó . "
pairs.english: “The scale weights are inside.”
pairs.hanzi: “里头是秤砣。”

pairs.target: lín zhào biàn bǎ bǐ gēxià .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao set down the brush.
pairs.hanzi: 林照便把笔搁下。

pairs.target: nánrén zǒu guòlái , yánzhe tā huà de jìhào zhúxiàng kàn .
pairs.english: The man came over and checked each item against the marks she had made.
pairs.hanzi: 男人走过来，沿着她画的记号逐项看。

pairs.target: měi cháwán yíyàng , huǒjì biàn bǎ tā tuīhuí yuánchù .
pairs.english: Whenever he finished checking an item, the worker slid it back into place.
pairs.hanzi: 每查完一样，伙计便把它推回原处。

pairs.target: tuī dào nà kǔn ruǎn lǒu shí , tā tèyì yòng shǒuzhǐ bǐ le gè èr .
pairs.english: As he got to the bundle of pliable baskets, he made a point of holding up two fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 推到那捆软篓时，他特意用手指比了个二。

pairs.target: " dào liǔ qiáo , nǐ zuò chēwěi . "
pairs.english: “You sit at the back until Willow Bridge.”
pairs.hanzi: “到柳桥，你坐车尾。”

pairs.target: nánrén bǎ dānzi zhéqǐlái ,
pairs.english: The man folded the list.
pairs.hanzi: 男人把单子折起来，

pairs.target: " lùshang zhào zhège chá .
pairs.english: “Check against this on the road.
pairs.hanzi: “路上照这个查。

pairs.target: xiè le nǎ jiàn , jì zài nǎ yìháng .
pairs.english: When something comes off, mark it on its line.
pairs.hanzi: 卸了哪件，记在哪一行。

pairs.target: zhǐguǎn jì , shǒu bié wǎng huò dǐxià shēn . "
pairs.english: Just keep the records. Keep your hands out from under the cargo.”
pairs.hanzi: 只管记，手别往货底下伸。”

pairs.target: " dào le liǔ qiáo ne ? "
pairs.english: “And when we get to Willow Bridge?”
pairs.hanzi: “到了柳桥呢？”

pairs.target: " dào le zài suàn .
pairs.english: “We'll see when we get there.
pairs.hanzi: “到了再算。

pairs.target: nàér ruò hái yòngdéshàng nǐ , nǐ zài wèn wǒ xià yìchéng . "
pairs.english: If we still have work for you there, ask me about the next leg then.”
pairs.hanzi: 那儿若还用得上你，你再问我下一程。”

pairs.target: lín zhàokàn le yìyǎn chēwěi .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao glanced at the back of the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 林照看了一眼车尾。

pairs.target: nà dìfāng āizhe chēlún , zuò jiǔ le dàgài yào chī yì zuǐ huī .
pairs.english: It was beside the wheel. Sit there long enough and she would probably get a mouthful of dust.
pairs.hanzi: 那地方挨着车轮，坐久了大概要吃一嘴灰。

pairs.target: tā háishì diǎn le tóu .
pairs.english: She nodded anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 她还是点了头。

pairs.target: nánrén bǎ bǐ ná huílái , cóng dānzi dǐxià chōuchū yìzhāng báozhǐ .
pairs.english: The man took back the brush and pulled a thin sheet of paper from beneath the list.
pairs.hanzi: 男人把笔拿回来，从单子底下抽出一张薄纸。

pairs.target: " jiào shénme ? "
pairs.english: “What's your name?”
pairs.hanzi: “叫什么？”

pairs.target: yígè lín zì dào le zuǐbiān .
pairs.english: The name Lin was on the tip of her tongue.
pairs.hanzi: 一个林字到了嘴边。

alignment.english: on the tip of her tongue

pairs.target: tā dīxiàtóu , kànjiàn nánrén yǐjīng bǎ bǐjiān rùn kāi , zhèng xuán zài zhǐ shàng děng tā .
pairs.english: She lowered her head and saw that the man had already moistened the brush tip. It hung over the paper as he waited for her.
pairs.hanzi: 她低下头，看见男人已经把笔尖润开，正悬在纸上等她。

pairs.target: zhǐyào bàochū liǎnggè zì , tā biàn huì xiěxiàqù , hé nàxiē huòwù de shùmù fàngzài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: She only had to say two characters and he would write them down beside the cargo figures.
pairs.hanzi: 只要报出两个字，他便会写下去，和那些货物的数目放在一起。

pairs.target: " chén níng . "
pairs.english: “Chen Ning.”
pairs.hanzi: “陈宁。”

pairs.target: nánrén xiě dé hěnkuài .
pairs.english: The man wrote very quickly.
pairs.hanzi: 男人写得很快。

pairs.target: chén zì de ěr páng tuō dé cháng , níng zì shàngtóu nà yìdiǎn dǎo luòde hěn qīng .
pairs.english: He drew out the left radical of Chen, then set down the dot atop Ning with a light touch.
pairs.hanzi: 陈字的耳旁拖得长，宁字上头那一点倒落得很轻。

pairs.target: tā chuī le chuī zhǐ , zhǐzhe hébiān yìliū ǎi péng , shuō yèlǐ kěyǐ zài nàlǐ xiējiǎo .
pairs.english: He blew on the paper, pointed to a row of low shelters by the river, and said she could rest there overnight.
pairs.hanzi: 他吹了吹纸，指着河边一溜矮棚，说夜里可以在那里歇脚。

pairs.target: péng xià duī zhe juàn hǎo de wěixí .
pairs.english: Rolled reed mats were stacked under the shelter.
pairs.hanzi: 棚下堆着卷好的苇席。

pairs.target: lín zhào jiè le yìzhāng , pù zài zuì lǐmiàn , kàozhe qiáng zuòxià lái .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao borrowed one, spread it in the farthest corner and sat against the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 林照借了一张，铺在最里面，靠着墙坐下来。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shuǐnáng nuó dào hǎo ná de dìfāng , mō chū jǐkē chǎo dòu , mànmàn jiáo le .
pairs.english: She moved the waterskin within reach, felt for a few roasted beans and chewed slowly.
pairs.hanzi: 她把水囊挪到好拿的地方，摸出几颗炒豆，慢慢嚼了。

pairs.target: hé fēng chuānguò péng jiǎo , chuī dé yījiǎo tiēzhù yāo .
pairs.english: A river breeze passed beneath the shelter and blew the hem of her clothes against her waist.
pairs.hanzi: 河风穿过棚脚，吹得衣角贴住腰。

pairs.target: xīn huàn de bù hái gān zhe , tā biàn méiyǒu zài qù jiē .
pairs.english: The fresh cloth was still dry, so she left it undisturbed.
pairs.hanzi: 新换的布还干着，她便没有再去揭。

pairs.target: yèlǐ yǒurén cóng péngwài jīngguò , xiégēn zài shíbǎn shàng yìqīng yìzhòng .
pairs.english: Someone passed outside the shelter in the night, their heels striking on the flagstones, light, then heavy.
pairs.hanzi: 夜里有人从棚外经过，鞋跟在石板上一轻一重。

pairs.target: tā bì zheyǎn tīng le liǎngbù , chàdiǎn yǐwéi nà rén yào tíngxiàlái jiào tā .
pairs.english: She listened with her eyes shut for two steps and almost thought the person would stop to call her.
pairs.hanzi: 她闭着眼听了两步，差点以为那人要停下来叫她。

pairs.target: jiǎobù guòqù le , hòutou yòu yǒurén tuō zhe kōng kuāng zǒuguò .
pairs.english: The footsteps passed. Someone else came after, dragging an empty basket.
pairs.hanzi: 脚步过去了，后头又有人拖着空筐走过。

pairs.target: tiānliàng qián , huǒjì lái juàn wěixí .
pairs.english: Before dawn the worker came to roll up the reed mats.
pairs.hanzi: 天亮前，伙计来卷苇席。

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎ xízi huángěi tā , fú zhe qiáng zhàn le piànkè ,
pairs.english: Lin Zhao gave him the mat back and stood against the wall for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把席子还给他，扶着墙站了片刻，

pairs.target: děng jiǎobèi nà zhèn téng huǎn xiàqù , cái zǒu dào chē biān .
pairs.english: She waited for the pain in her instep to ease, then walked to the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 等脚背那阵疼缓下去，才走到车边。

pairs.target: huī mào nánrén zhèngzài diǎn rén .
pairs.english: The man in the gray cap was calling the roll.
pairs.hanzi: 灰帽男人正在点人。

pairs.target: tā niànwán qiántou jǐgè míngzì , fānguò zhǐ lái .
pairs.english: When he finished reading the first few names, he turned the sheet over.
pairs.hanzi: 他念完前头几个名字，翻过纸来。

pairs.target: " chén níng . "
pairs.english: “Chen Ning.”
pairs.hanzi: “陈宁。”

pairs.target: tā tīng qīng le nà liǎnggè zì , guò le yì xī cái dāying .
pairs.english: She clearly heard the two syllables, then took a breath before answering.
pairs.hanzi: 她听清了那两个字，过了一息才答应。

pairs.target: huǒjì yǐjīng bǎ chēwěi de lǒuzǐ wǎng lǐ nuó le nuó , gěi tā kōng chū yíkuài dìfāng .
pairs.english: The worker had already shifted the basket at the back of the cart inward, clearing a place for her.
pairs.hanzi: 伙计已经把车尾的篓子往里挪了挪，给她空出一块地方。

alignment.english: at the back of the cart

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎ shuǐnáng dìshàngqù , zìjǐ yě fú zhe chē bǎn zuò le shàngqù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao handed up the waterskin, then braced herself against the cart bed and sat down too.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把水囊递上去，自己也扶着车板坐了上去。

pairs.target: chēlún cóng shífèng lǐ niǎn guòqù , qīngqīng yídùn .
pairs.english: The wheel rolled across a crack in the paving and caught for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 车轮从石缝里碾过去，轻轻一顿。

pairs.target: tā de shǒu dā zài chēyán shàng , méiyǒu zài wǎng xià shēn .
pairs.english: Her hand rested on the cart's edge. She didn't reach down again.
pairs.hanzi: 她的手搭在车沿上，没有再往下伸。
